title: Can an AI Finish a Browser Task?
script: Can an AI finish a browser task without quietly handing it back to me? I asked for five coding projects: stars, license, language, last update, and a source for each row. It had to browse the actual project pages. Any time I stepped in went into the intervention log. I checked every entry against the source, including whether the update field meant what it said. It returned [ROWS_RETURNED] rows. [CORRECT_FIELDS] fields checked out, with [INTERVENTIONS] interventions. [BOUNDARY_OF_AUTONOMY]. Did it act like an agent, or an assistant?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Research five open-source coding projects and prepare a sourced comparison.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: Can an AI finish a browser task without quietly handing it back to me?
The table looks finished. Are the sources right?
I kept my hands off the browser. Did it finish?
strongestHook: Can an AI finish a browser task without quietly handing it back to me?
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Research five open-source coding projects and prepare a sourced comparison. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 60–90 minutes core experiment; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Use the fixed repositories facebook/react, microsoft/vscode, vercel/next.js, vitejs/vite and sveltejs/svelte. Record stars at collection time, license identifier, primary repository language and latest commit time on the default branch; include a source URL for each. Use a fresh browser agent with a 15-minute cap. Audit all 20 fields and five source links manually against dated captures. Record blocked access, wrong sources and human interventions. Treat volatile star counts as recording-day observations.
evidenceRequirements: Verify access, correct entries and interventions; imported feature claims require checking.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “Does The Agent Finish” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: [BOUNDARY_OF_AUTONOMY]. Did it act like an agent, or an assistant?
instagramCaption: Can an AI Finish a Browser Task?. Research five open-source coding projects and prepare a sourced comparison. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. [BOUNDARY_OF_AUTONOMY]. Did it act like an agent, or an assistant?
tiktokCaption: Can an AI Finish a Browser Task?. AGENT OR ASSISTANT?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
